specification.objective: Remove the empty Kanban sync-status strip from desktop while keeping it on mobile layouts.

requirements.statement: At the shared desktop breakpoint (width >= 1080 px), do not render the 54 px Kanban sync-status top bar, allowing the project overview to start immediately below the workspace shell.
Below 1080 px, retain the Kanban sync-status top bar and its existing status behavior for mobile layouts.
Keep Kanban project selection, board controls, workspace navigation, and route behavior unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: At 1440 px, neither the kanban-topbar nor its Sincronizado status is present, while the project overview and board remain visible.
At 1079 px and below, the sync-status top bar remains visible.
The full affected Kanban page widget test suite passes.

invariants.statement: The existing 1080 px workspace responsive breakpoint and all desktop Kanban project, view, metric, refresh, and board controls remain unchanged.
No dependencies, backend behavior, API, authentication, authorization, route, or persisted data changes are introduced.

forbidden_states.statement: The sync-only 54 px top bar remains visible on desktop or the mobile sync status is removed.

inputs.statement: The available viewport width compared with the shared 1080 px workspace breakpoint.

outputs.statement: A desktop Kanban page without the empty sync strip, retaining the strip on mobile.

failure_semantics.statement: On the locked baseline, the desktop Kanban test fails because the top bar is still rendered.

argv: builds Kanban without redundant page titles and keeps board bounded
builds Kanban without redundant page titles and keeps board bounded
